summary: DeFi Technologies filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, disclosing that Nasdaq granted an additional 180-day compliance period, until March 1, 2027, to regain the minimum bid price of $1.00 per share under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company previously received a deficiency notice on March 5, 2026, and failed to cure by September 1, 2026. Trading continues unchanged on Nasdaq under DEFT. The company must maintain a closing bid above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. Watch for potential reverse stock split or other remedial actions to avoid delisting.
